subject: Marketing RFP — SeamlessAccess
body:
Dear Heather,

I hope this message finds you well. I came across SeamlessAccess' RFP for a Marketing & Outreach Consultant, and I wanted to express our interest in supporting your efforts to strengthen and professionalize your marketing strategy. The scope of work—audience segmentation, messaging refinement, content planning, and campaign execution—aligns closely with our expertise, and we're excited about the opportunity to contribute to SeamlessAccess' impact within the global research and library community.

Could you kindly share any next steps or additional details about the submission process? We'd be happy to provide any information needed to move forward.

Looking forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,

subject: Website RFP — Accountability Lab
body:
Dear Procurement Team,

I hope this email finds you well. I came across Accountability Lab's RFP for the redesign and rebuild of your global nonprofit website, and I wanted to express our interest in supporting this important project.

The focus on improved user experience, accessibility, multilingual support, and performance—along with the migration and integration requirements—aligns closely with the type of work we specialize in. We're particularly drawn to the opportunity to help create a refreshed design system that reflects Accountability Lab's visual identity and mission.

Could you kindly share any additional details on next steps or requirements for submitting a proposal? We'd be happy to answer any preliminary questions or provide further information about our approach to similar projects.

Looking forward to hearing from you.

Best regards,
